## Activity

During November 2024, East City Eye Clinic maintained planned screening activity. The clinic team completed 226 captures during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall activity was recorded for operational monitoring and review, with the completed captures providing the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading in the great majority of cases. A total of 3 captures were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.3. These cases were recorded separately from the gradable images to support routine quality monitoring. The result indicates that image acquisition was generally consistent during the month, while the ungradable captures remain relevant to ongoing review of clinic processes and image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 71 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 7 days. This measure records the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading and is included to support monitoring of the service pathway. The activity, image quality and grading results provide the monthly operational position for East City Eye Clinic in November 2024.
